judgments.fix: That is the requested count in the ordinary case, and fewer when the run terminated before the call's last frame, the stopping frame counted. A stop inside the last frame requested returns the full count, so a harness reads `lifecycle` to detect the stop.
judgments.note: Commit 401b858e records the change, following the 2026-11-05 docstring audit (ledger A8, sim.jl:2115 row). It corrected the step! docstring to 'A stop inside the last frame requested returns the full count, so read lifecycle to detect a stop' and left the spec alone. The fix also has to replace the next spec sentence, 'That return is how a harness detects the truncation without inspecting the clock'. A replay end also returns fewer frames without any termination (sim.jl:2264). So the wording goes beyond this one claim.
